title: Team docs got a clearer map
summary:
A documentation day: clearer team roles, refreshed internal context, and a developer community team starting to take form.

The team documentation was refreshed so the people and work behind pollinations are easier to find. Organizational archaeology, but with fewer dusty binders.

Documentation now outlines a third founder role, updates responsibilities for Thomas and Elliot, and records the formation of a developer community team.
